name: MAIO AI Meta Tag Generator
author: positiomaio

sections.description:
MAIO AI Meta Tag Generator connects to the MAIO AI service (maioptimizer.com) to generate optimized SEO meta tags for your posts automatically using Google Gemini.

Key features:

  • Automatic AI-powered generation of SEO titles and meta descriptions
  • Compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO
  • Bulk processing of multiple posts at once
  • Manual editing with live character counters and Google preview
  • Multilingual support (generates in the language of your content)

Free plan:

  • 5 AI generations per month for blog posts
  • No credit card required
  • Sign up for free at maioptimizer.com

Paid plans offer higher monthly limits and support for additional content types (pages, products, custom post types).

Requires: A free MAIO account at maioptimizer.com to use AI generation.

Privacy Policy

MAIO AI Meta Tag Generator respects your privacy:

  • No personal data from end users is collected
  • Only post content (plain text) is sent to the MAIO service for AI processing
  • Content is NOT stored permanently
  • All communications are encrypted with SSL/TLS
  • Only anonymous usage statistics are stored (generation count per domain)

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide AI generation functionality. These services are only contacted when you use the AI generation feature.

MAIO AI Service (maioptimizer.com)

  • Purpose: AI-powered SEO meta tag generation and account management
  • Data sent: Post content (plain text), domain name, API key, generation count
  • URL: https://maioptimizer.com
  • Privacy policy: https://maioptimizer.com/privacy
  • Terms of service: https://maioptimizer.com/terms

Google Gemini AI (via maioptimizer.com)

  • Purpose: Natural language processing for meta tag generation
  • Data sent: Post content (plain text), via the MAIO service
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to MAIO AI Meta Tag Generator in the WordPress admin menu
  3. Click the Account tab and enter your MAIO API key
  4. Sign up for free at maioptimizer.com if you don’t have an account
  5. Select blog posts and generate AI-optimized meta tags
sections.faq:
Is a MAIO account required?

Yes. AI generation requires a free MAIO account at maioptimizer.com. The free plan includes 5 generations per month. No credit card is required.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO Pack. The plugin automatically detects which one is active and saves the generated meta tags to the correct fields.

What data is sent to the MAIO service?

Only the plain text content of your post, your domain name, and your API key. No personal data from end users is ever collected or transmitted.
